introduction: This spec defines the configurable merge strategy feature for agent-fox, enabling teams to select between direct squash-merge, local branch retention, or GitHub Pull Request creation as the post-session integration behavior. Note: requirements referencing internal module APIs (session_lifecycle.py, fix_pipeline.py, github.py, protocol.py, platform_factory) are based on PRD descriptions and should be cross-checked against the installed codebase before implementation.

user_story.goal: define `merge_strategy` in my config file or rely on its default
user_story.benefit: I can choose how feature branches are integrated without any migration effort

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: Pydantic model instantiation succeeds and `merge_strategy` equals `'direct'` when the field is absent from the input

acceptance_criteria.action: accepts the value and stores it on the model instance
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: model field equals the supplied literal string with no validation error
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a config file is parsed with `merge_strategy` set to `'direct'`, `'branch'`, or `'pr'`

acceptance_criteria.action: raises a Pydantic `ValidationError` listing the invalid value
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: exception is raised; model is not constructed
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: the config file contains `merge_strategy` set to any string other than `'direct'`, `'branch'`, or `'pr'`

acceptance_criteria.action: includes `merge_strategy` in `_VISIBLE_SECTIONS` and `_PROMOTED_DEFAULTS` using the same pattern applied to `integration_branch` and `force_clean`, so it appears with its default value in the generated config template
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: generated config template contains the line `merge_strategy = "direct"`

edge_cases.action: silently defaults `merge_strategy` to `'direct'` via Pydantic's default-value mechanism with no warning or error
edge_cases.trigger: an existing config file that predates this feature is loaded

edge_cases.return_contract: exception is raised; model is not constructed
edge_cases.error_condition: `merge_strategy` is supplied as an empty string or `null`

user_story.goal: have my current workflow preserved when `merge_strategy` is `'direct'` or absent
user_story.benefit: I experience zero regressions from this feature introduction

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `harvest()` exactly as before, squash-merges the `feature_branch` into `integration_branch`, and pushes to origin; emits no additional log output beyond existing harvest/merge log lines
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `('completed', None, touched_files_from_harvest, False)`

acceptance_criteria.action: calls `_harvest_and_push()` and closes the originating issue with a comment as per current behavior
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `('completed', None, touched_files_from_harvest, False)`

user_story.goal: have the feature branch kept locally after a session without being merged or pushed
user_story.benefit: I can inspect, modify, or manually integrate the branch at my own pace

acceptance_criteria.action: skips `harvest()`, does not push the `feature_branch` to origin, calls `get_changed_files(repo_root, feature_branch, integration_branch)` to populate `touched_files`, emits an `INFO` log line `Merge strategy is 'branch' — feature branch '{branch_name}' kept locally.`, and includes the branch name in the standard session summary printed to stdout

acceptance_criteria.action: skips `harvest()`, does not push the `feature_branch`, does NOT close the originating issue, and posts a comment to the originating issue with the exact text: `Fix branch created: \`{branch_name}\`. Merge strategy is set to \`branch\` — please review and merge manually.`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`

edge_cases.action: proceeds normally, returning an empty `touched_files` list; no special handling or error is emitted

acceptance_criteria.action: in `session_lifecycle.py` and `fix_pipeline.py` pass all parameters explicitly as keyword arguments; no positional arguments are used

user_story.goal: have `create_pr()` defined as a first-class method on `PlatformProtocol`

acceptance_criteria.action: declares `async def create_pr(self, *, title: str, body: str, head: str, base: str) -> str` as an abstract method with a docstring stating it returns the PR's `html_url` and raises `IntegrationError` on API failure excluding idempotent 422 duplicate-PR responses

requirements.title: Return type contract across all modes

user_story.benefit: no callers of these functions require changes from the introduction of this feature

acceptance_criteria.action: always return `tuple[str, str | None, list[str], bool]` in the form `(status, error_message, touched_files, is_non_retryable)` regardless of which `merge_strategy` mode is active; the PR URL is surfaced via log and session summary, never in the return tuple
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: in all three modes and all error sub-cases: status is `'completed'`, error_message is `None`, touched_files is a `list[str]`, is_non_retryable is `False`

requirements.title: Operation sequence integrity for pr mode

user_story.goal: have the PR mode operations execute in the correct order with no partial state on early failure
user_story.benefit: I never end up with an inconsistent git/GitHub state from a failed run

acceptance_criteria.action: executes `'pr'` mode operations in the mandatory sequence: (1) call `create_platform_safe()`, (2) if `None` fall back to `'branch'` mode with no branch push, (3) if platform available push `feature_branch` to origin, (4) call `get_changed_files()`, (5) call `build_pr_body()`, (6) call `platform.create_pr()`, (7) on `IntegrationError` log error and fall back to `'branch'` mode semantics, (8) on success log `INFO` with PR URL
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: no step in the sequence is reordered; the platform guard always precedes any branch push

edge_cases.action: the exception propagates to the existing pipeline error handling; the merge strategy code does not silently catch unexpected exceptions
edge_cases.return_contract: exception propagates; caller's standard error path handles it
edge_cases.error_condition: any exception other than `IntegrationError` is raised during the `'pr'` mode operation sequence (e.g. unexpected `RuntimeError` from aiohttp or git)

correctness_properties.title: merge_strategy config field is always valid
correctness_properties.invariant: `merge_strategy` is always one of the string literals `'direct'`, `'branch'`, or `'pr'`; it is never `None`, empty, or an unrecognized value

correctness_properties.title: Return tuple shape is invariant across all merge modes
correctness_properties.invariant: the return value is always `tuple[str, str | None, list[str], bool]` where `status == 'completed'`, `error_message is None`, `touched_files` is a `list[str]` (possibly empty), and `is_non_retryable == False`, regardless of which `merge_strategy` mode is active or whether partial failure occurred

correctness_properties.title: Platform guard always precedes branch push in pr mode
correctness_properties.invariant: `create_platform_safe()` is always called and its result is checked before any git push to origin is attempted; a `None` result always causes immediate fallback to `'branch'` mode without any push occurring

correctness_properties.title: build_pr_body is a pure function
correctness_properties.for_any: call to `build_pr_body()` with the same arguments
correctness_properties.invariant: returns the identical string output on every invocation; has no observable side effects; does not read from or write to external state

correctness_properties.title: NullPlatform.create_pr always raises NotImplementedError
correctness_properties.invariant: `NotImplementedError` is raised immediately with no network call, no git state mutation, and no side effects

correctness_properties.title: direct mode produces no behavioral change
correctness_properties.for_any: execution where `merge_strategy` is `'direct'` or absent from the config
correctness_properties.invariant: the code path is identical to the pre-feature implementation: `harvest()` is called, `feature_branch` is squash-merged into `integration_branch`, pushed to origin, and no additional log lines are emitted

correctness_properties.title: GitHubPlatform.create_pr makes exactly one API attempt
correctness_properties.invariant: at most one `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` request is sent; a follow-up `GET` is only issued on a duplicate-PR 422 response; no other retries are attempted

execution_paths.title: af code session with pr mode — successful PR creation

steps.action: runs `af code` with `merge_strategy = 'pr'` in the workspace config
completes the coding session and invokes `_harvest_and_integrate()`
calls `create_platform_safe(config, project_root)` to obtain the GitHub platform client
pushes the `feature_branch` to origin via git
calls `get_changed_files(repo_root, feature_branch, integration_branch)` to build the changed files list
calls `build_pr_body()` with `spec_name`, `task_group_id`, `task_group_title`, and `changed_files`
calls `platform.create_pr(title=..., body=..., head=feature_branch, base=integration_branch)`
sends `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` and receives HTTP 201 with `html_url`
emits `INFO` log `Pull request created: {html_url}` and returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`
prints session summary including the PR URL to stdout and exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: af code session with branch mode

steps.action: runs `af code` with `merge_strategy = 'branch'` in the workspace config
completes the coding session and invokes `_harvest_and_integrate()`
skips `harvest()` and does not push the `feature_branch` to origin
calls `get_changed_files(repo_root, feature_branch, integration_branch)` to populate `touched_files`
emits `INFO` log `Merge strategy is 'branch' — feature branch '{branch_name}' kept locally.`
returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`
prints session summary including the branch name to stdout and exits with code 0

execution_paths.title: nightshift fix session with pr mode — successful PR creation

steps.action: triggers a fix session for a GitHub issue and invokes `_integrate_fix()` with `merge_strategy = 'pr'`
calls `create_platform_safe(config, project_root)` to obtain the GitHub platform client
pushes the `feature_branch` to origin
calls `get_changed_files()` and `build_pr_body()` with `issue_number` and `issue_title`
calls `platform.create_pr(title='Fix #{issue_number}: {issue_title}', body=..., head=feature_branch, base=integration_branch)`
sends `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` and receives HTTP 201; PR body contains `Fixes #{issue_number}`
emits `INFO` log with PR URL; does NOT close the originating issue; returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`
marks the job as complete

execution_paths.title: pr mode fallback — platform not configured

steps.action: initiates a session with `merge_strategy = 'pr'` but `GITHUB_PAT` is absent or `platform.type` is not `'github'`
calls `create_platform_safe(config, project_root)` which returns `None`
emits `WARNING` log `Merge strategy is 'pr' but platform is not configured — falling back to 'branch' mode.`
executes `'branch'` mode behavior without any branch push to origin

steps.actor: af code CLI or nightshift daemon
steps.action: receives `('completed', None, touched_files, False)` and completes normally with exit code 0

execution_paths.title: pr mode partial failure — branch pushed but PR creation fails in nightshift

steps.action: invokes `_integrate_fix()` with `merge_strategy = 'pr'`; platform is available
pushes the `feature_branch` to origin successfully
calls `platform.create_pr()` which raises `IntegrationError`
emits `ERROR` log `PR creation failed. Branch available at: https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/tree/{branch_name}`
posts branch-mode issue comment to the originating issue: `Fix branch created: \`{branch_name}\`. Merge strategy is set to \`branch\` — please review and merge manually.`
returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)` without closing the issue or rolling back the remote branch
marks the job as complete with no retry triggered

execution_paths.title: pr mode idempotent duplicate PR handling

steps.actor: nightshift daemon or af code CLI
steps.action: retries a session where a PR was already created for the `feature_branch`
pushes the `feature_branch` to origin and calls `platform.create_pr()`
receives HTTP 422 from `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` with message indicating PR already exists
queries existing PR via `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?head={head}&base={base}` and returns the existing `html_url`
treats the result as success; emits `INFO` log with the existing PR URL; returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`
runs `af code` with no `merge_strategy` field in config (defaults to `'direct'`)
completes the coding session and invokes `_harvest_and_integrate()`
calls `harvest()` exactly as before, squash-merging the `feature_branch` into `integration_branch` and pushing to origin
returns `('completed', None, touched_files_from_harvest, False)` with no additional log lines
prints existing session summary and exits with code 0

error_handling.condition: `merge_strategy` is set to an invalid value in the config file
error_handling.behavior: Pydantic raises `ValidationError` during config parsing; model is not constructed; the process fails at config load time before any session begins

error_handling.condition: `create_platform_safe()` returns `None` in `'pr'` mode (GITHUB_PAT missing or platform.type is not 'github')
error_handling.behavior: logs `WARNING` `Merge strategy is 'pr' but platform is not configured — falling back to 'branch' mode.`; executes `'branch'` mode behavior; no branch push is attempted; session completes normally with exit code 0

error_handling.condition: git push of `feature_branch` to origin fails before `create_pr()` is called (network error, auth failure, rejected push)
error_handling.behavior: exception propagates to the existing pipeline error handling in `session_lifecycle.py` and `fix_pipeline.py`; no special handling in the merge strategy code; no partial state remains from the merge strategy logic

error_handling.condition: `feature_branch` is successfully pushed but `create_pr()` raises `IntegrationError` in an `af code` session
error_handling.behavior: logs `ERROR` with remote branch URL `https://github.com/{owner}/{repo}/tree/{branch_name}`; falls back to `'branch'` mode semantics; remote branch is not rolled back; returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`; exit code is 0

error_handling.condition: `feature_branch` is successfully pushed but `create_pr()` raises `IntegrationError` in a nightshift fix session
error_handling.behavior: logs `ERROR` with remote branch URL; posts branch-mode issue comment to originating issue; falls back to `'branch'` mode semantics; nightshift job is marked complete with no retry; remote branch is not rolled back; returns `('completed', None, touched_files, False)`

error_handling.condition: GitHub returns HTTP 422 for `POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` with a message indicating a PR already exists for the head branch
error_handling.behavior: `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` queries the existing PR via `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls?head={head}&base={base}` and returns the existing `html_url`; treated as success; no `IntegrationError` is raised

error_handling.condition: GitHub returns any non-201 HTTP response not matching the duplicate-PR 422 condition
error_handling.behavior: `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` raises `IntegrationError` with details of the failure; caller's partial-failure handling takes effect

error_handling.condition: aiohttp request to GitHub times out or connection is dropped during `create_pr()`
error_handling.behavior: aiohttp exception propagates from `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` without being caught; the caller's partial-failure handling (ERR-4 or ERR-5) takes effect

error_handling.condition: HTTP 422 is returned but the subsequent `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls` query finds no existing PR
error_handling.behavior: `GitHubPlatform.create_pr()` raises `IntegrationError` to signal the unexpected state
raises `NotImplementedError` with the specified message immediately; no network call or git state mutation occurs
